model: min-max transfer of indexed stored generalized eigenvalues to exact Gaussian-weighted P1 forms on the stored polygon
scope: This transfers only from the stored binary matrices to the exact Gaussian-weighted finite-element forms on the same stored polygon. It does not prove continuum Ritz or polygon-to-circle domain transfer.
theorem: If |a_exact-a_stored| <= eta_A m_stored and mu_- m_stored <= m_exact <= mu_+ m_stored, then (lambda_stored_j-eta_A)/mu_+ <= lambda_exact_j <= (lambda_stored_j+eta_A)/mu_- for every indexed j.
